_comment: SIMULATION, assumed parameters. Every time and distance below is a placeholder. Replace it with a measured value and change its note. Cycle as in notebooks/week-03/Choton/Choton_Week3_Notebook.md (team-confirmed 2026-11-16).

items_per_box.note: SETTING: team decision 1 card + 2 candies (Choton_Week3_Notebook.md, Information for the Team; confirmed 2026-11-16); order card, candy, candy as in Choton's program. Not a measurement

random_seed.note: SETTING: not a measurement; fixed so that the random item order on belt A repeats between runs

belt_a_speed_mm_s.note: ASSUMED: object conveyor (belt A) speed not measured yet

item_spacing_mm.note: ASSUMED: distance between items placed on belt A; feeding by hand, not measured; a full set (3 items) must stay in the pick area while the camera confirms it

pick_area_length_mm.note: ASSUMED: length of the camera's pick area; the 5 calibration crosses span about 236 mm in robot Y (Choton code/config/homography.json), belt direction not confirmed

set_confirm_time_s.note: ASSUMED: the program needs the full set in 3 pictures in a row before it stops belt A (Choton); frame time not measured

detection_time_s.note: ASSUMED: time for the camera to see that the open box stands still; not measured

pictures_time_s.note: ASSUMED: robot moves home out of the camera view and takes 8 pictures (Choton); not timed

pick_time_s.note: ASSUMED: above the object, down, suction on (0.6 s wait), up; not timed as a whole

move_to_box_time_s.note: ASSUMED: M1 Pro move pick area -> box not timed yet; also used for the return move and the move home

place_time_s.note: ASSUMED: down into the box, suction off, blow-off 0.2 s, wait 0.3 s, up; not timed as a whole

lid_time_s.note: ASSUMED: pick the lid, carry it over the box edge, put it on (Choton's code); not yet tried on the real robot

belt_b_speed_mm_s.note: ASSUMED: box conveyor (belt B, run by the Arduino Nano) speed not measured yet

box_start_to_s1_mm.note: ASSUMED: distance a new box travels on belt B to the Nano's box sensor; not measured

box_removal_time_s.note: ASSUMED: the operator takes the closed box away (team decision 2026-11-16); time not measured

timeouts_s.note: ASSUMED: generous margins over the assumed nominal times; FEED_SET is long because unneeded items pass by (Choton's program stops belt A after 60 s without objects)
